about: Ground shadow specs for tools/artwork/cast_shadows.py (see its docstring and docs/assets/lighting.md). Buildings: method mesh casts content-src/gfx/shadows/mesh/<frame>s.png (tools/artwork/mesh_shadows.py); length = screen px of throw per px of height, art direction per building (default 0.6). Each building keeps its block geometry as the fallback: boxes are HD pixels of the frame, blocks [x0, y0, x1, y1, height], spires [x0, y0, x1, y1, base_y, base_height]. Damaged variants share their building's spec.
